c: Changes and change tasks come to you in the workspace's Tasks lists: Assigned to you and Assigned to your group.
say: Changes and change tasks come to you in the workspace's task lists: assigned to you, and assigned to your group.

c: Select a change and choose Assign to me. It refuses if you aren't in the change's group, and fills the group if you have only one.
say: Select a change and choose assign to me. It refuses if you are not in the change's group, and fills in the group if you have only one. Change tasks don't have it: set the assignee yourself.

c: The change opens with Save and More actions in the header, the side panel, and Related records such as Change Tasks and Approvers.
say: The change opens with save and more actions in the header, the side panel on the right, and related records such as change tasks and approvers.

c: Agent Assist searches with the short description. Change Related Incidents lists active incidents opened since the change started.
say: Agent assist searches with the short description. The change related incidents source lists the active incidents opened since the change started.

c: On such an incident, Link to Incident makes your change the incident's Caused by.
say: On such an incident, link to incident makes your change the incident's caused by.

c: Collaborate starts a Sidebar discussion about the change. Nobody is emailed: mention people who must act.
say: Collaborate starts a sidebar discussion about the change. Nobody is emailed about it, so mention the people who must act.
